text: Hey, quick question—does anyone know if there’s a specific onboarding checklist for new support engineers? I remember seeing something about it but can’t find the link now.
Yeah, there is! There’s actually a dedicated onboarding issue template for support engineers. I think it’s in the handbook somewhere under onboarding templates.

Here’s the link I have: https://gitlab.com/gitlab-com/support/support-training/blob/main/.gitlab/issue_templates/New%20Support%20Team%20Member%20Start%20Here.md. That should walk you through all the steps for new support folks.
Perfect, thanks Elena! That’s exactly what I needed 🙏
